name: uv_mutex_unlock_inlined

ownership.argument: Recorded as the evidenced entry point for the unlock; the real release work is pthread_mutex_unlock_core 0xC205430. This also confirms uv_mutex_lock 0xC1E9B1C from the caller side rather than only from uv_mutex_init.

provenance.source: Not a function start: it is the label the inlined uv unlock calls. ensureJsClass 0xC867040 wraps its class-id allocation in exactly this pair - 0xC2DCDA8 (which tail-calls pthread_mutex_lock 0xC1E9B1C) for lock and 0xC2DCDC4 (which tail-calls 0xC204F08) for unlock - so the pair is provably the libuv lock/unlock as the firmware inlines it.

notes: Recorded as the evidenced entry point for the unlock; the real release work is pthread_mutex_unlock_core 0xC205430. This also confirms uv_mutex_lock 0xC1E9B1C from the caller side rather than only from uv_mutex_init.
